card.name: The 'one-time' and 'once' wording
card.fires_on: The word 'time' or '-time' right after 'one', and also 'once' meaning a single occurrence. It also fires on the word after 'one-time', such as 'event' or 'Only'.

modes.label: one-time wording
modes.description: '-time' or 'time' completing 'one-time' before a noun like dose, event or funding.
modes.example: Do not repeat the one<<-time>> starting dose after the first injection.

modes.label: once as a single occurrence
modes.description: The word 'once' meaning a single occurrence, in instructions.
modes.example: You only have to create a user account<< once>>.

modes.label: word after one-time
modes.description: The word right after 'one-time', such as 'event' or 'Only'.
modes.example: other one-time<< event>>; and - amount of toxic chemical

card.writes: It seems to suppress other word completions and slightly favors words meaning a single occurrence, like '一次' and '_ONCE'.
card.plain: It marks the phrase 'one-time' or 'once', meaning something happens a single time.
